attribution.rule: §2.3: a component accounts for the C3 loss if its single-change contrast (A1 embedding, A2 decoder + count head) is clear and T̄ >= +16.2 % (half of the registered R2b +32.3 %); else interaction if A3 or A4 meets that; else, if none is clear, R2b is reported as not reproduced in parts.
attribution.verdict: interaction: neither single change accounts for the C3 loss, but A3 does

A2.measures: the query-isolated decoder and count head alone

A3.measures: decoder and count head, given the new embedding

A4.measures: the new embedding, given the new decoder

interaction_exploratory.definition: (e_C3 e_C2)/(e_C3e e_C2dc) - 1; > 0 = the two changes hurt more together than multiplicatively
